sc: The 'Festive' title scroll is an item that can be obtained by opening purple Christmas Presents, which can be obtained from the 2023 Christmas event.
The agile outfit enhancer is a reward enhancer that grants an additional lap of progress towards the agile armour per completed lap.
When obtained from Motherlode Maw or Wythien, 25 charges are added to Wythien's enhancer management interface.

Amare Cape.x: Amare Cape is a female-only back slot cosmetic override. It is part of the Amare outfit.

sc: It is also a reward from Myths of the White Lands.
The Antisanguine? item itself is never obtained.
Two are made from four argonlike bars at the anvil west of Mage Arena.
It can be made at a forge and anvil using 2 bane bars, requiring 1,800 progress to complete, granting a total of 1,400 Smithing experience.
The barrier (class 1) from the Stealing Creation minigame is made by using a class 1 of sacred clay on a creation kiln.

Black heraldic armour set 1 (sk).x: Black heraldic armour set 1 (sk) is an item obtained by exchanging a set of items with a Grand Exchange clerk via their right-click "Exchange" option, followed by the "Sets" tab and clicking on the appropriate item set within the Item Sets interface.

sc: A blank teleport crystal is given to the player by Arianwyn, leader of the rebel elves, at the beginning of the quest Within the Light.
It is made by using the fibula bone with a pot of vinegar.
It is also obtainable as a reward from master reward caskets.
Brutish Mace was a main hand melee weapon cosmetic override that could be unlocked by purchasing the Brutish Melee Weapon Pack.
It is obtained by using the "Harvest-twigs" option on a cedar tree inside the Phoenix Lair.
Cerberus is a pet unlocked by redeeming a Cerberus pet token or by clicking Cerberus in the Treasure Hunter interface during the Cerberus Rush promotion starting on 17 April 2024.
Despite the official concept art showing growth stages for the Cerberus Companion Pet, the pet is only available as an adult.
The chinchompa hunt map could be obtained from Menowin during Spring Fayre and may be regained from Diango or Ianto if destroyed after the event.
A bond could be used to obtain all the weekly prizes.
Previous prizes could be bought from the Chinchompa Reward Shop, opened by right-clicking the map.

h: A possible reward from the daily free item from the calendar on 18 December or through Treasure Hunter on 12, 18, and 24 December
sc: The Christmas jumper token (Christmas tree) is a token that can be redeemed to unlock the Christmas jumper (Christmas tree) override, destroying the token in the process after a confirmation.
The Clover Wand is a cosmetic override unlocked by redeeming a clover wand token.
Clue scroll (easy) is a cryptic clue obtained from easy sealed clue scrolls.

Clue scroll (hard) - When no weapons are.x: Clue scroll (hard) is a cryptic clue obtained from hard sealed clue scrolls. It contains a clue to solve Treasure Trails.

sc: Clue scroll (medium) is an anagram clue obtained from medium sealed clue scrolls.
It is found by searching a crate in the storeroom.
It is a possible reward from Treasure Hunter.
Cosy Pyjamas (Trees) is a cosmetic override outfit that is unlocked by being on Santa's nice list during the 2024 Christmas event on any week starting from 8 December.
Cowbells are available from any dairy cow, if a player has started the Cold War quest and has level 15 Thieving.
It is also possible to obtain a jar from the Motherlode Maw.
As can be done with all impling jars, the crystal impling jar can be traded in singularly to Elnock Inquisitor for three empty impling jars.

It is obtained by upgrading a tier 70 variant with 2 Hermodic plates, 2 pieces of greater ensouled cloth, 1 spool of greater ensouled thread, and 25 miasma runes after the completion of Kili's Knowledge VI (power).
The diviner's headwear add-on is an item that can be obtained as a reward from an experience-earning Guthixian Cache or purchased via Vic's Store for 250 credits.
It is obtained in the Parts bin next to the Inventor's workbench and can be disassembled.
It was originally unlocked by completing contracts during the Faceless Assassins promotion.

tx: The tier of troves and the rate at which they can be found at depends on the tier of pontifex shadow ring worn.
sc: Elder Trove (Jas, T2) is an item obtained by killing Nodon dragonkin or Kerapac, the bound, from the water filtration system at Het's Oasis, or from completing certain collections.

Elf-style wig (blue, female).x: The blue elf-style wig is part of the elven outfit item set. It gives no bonuses and is a cosmetic item.

sc: It is given by Anya when players hand some silver and sanguine spines to her.

Feathered serpent headdress (red, male).x: The red feathered serpent headdress is part of the feathered serpent outfit item set. It gives no bonuses and is a cosmetic item.

sc: It can be found by the entrance to the TzHaar Fight Pits.
Fletching potion is made by mixing clean wergali and a wimpy feather in a vial of water, giving 132 Herblore experience.

Flourishing Fairy Petal Coronet.x: The Flourishing Fairy Petal Coronet is a head slot cosmetic override that can be unlocked by purchasing the Flourishing Fairy outfit.

sc: It is created by using flypaper and a pot of flour on the silver pot.

h: Path of the Creators - Part II
sc: Ful Templar's Outfit is a cosmetic override set unlocked by completing tier 45 of the Path of the Creators - Part II Yak Track with the premier pass.
It is obtained through the Ghostweave Returns Treasure Hunter promotion from 25 October 2017 00:00 UTC to 30 October 2017 23:59 UTC.
It was also previously available from 24 October 2014 00:00 UTC to 3 November 2014 23:59 UTC through Treasure Hunter, skilling, or killing monsters.
Gnarly is an item obtained during the quest, A Fairy Tale III - Battle at Ork's Rift.

Goebie Warpaint (Yellow) Bottom.x: The Goebie Warpaint (Yellow) Bottom is a legs slot cosmetic override that can be obtained by completing Call of the Ancestors.

sc: Grapes of Saradomin are obtained by harvesting godly grapevines, which will yield random types of god grapes.
It was released with the Evolution of Combat, as an uncommon drop from grifolapines.
Group Ironman helm is a head slot item that Group Ironman Mode players can obtain from the armour stand at the Iron Enclave.
Hedge Teleport token (untradeable) is an unlock token that can be won from Santa's Christmas Present.
It can be redeemed to unlock the Hedge Teleport animation override, destroying the token in the process after a confirmation prompt.
The hobgoblin scrawlings are a book obtained while training Dungeoneering as a reward for completing a dungeon which appears by the exit door after killing the Hobgoblin Geomancer.
Once the book has been obtained once it is impossible to obtain it again.
Inert fire rune fragments are an item obtained during the Succession quest by using one measly fire rune on a sharp rock in the cave below the Mage Arena.
The Inverted Summoning master skillcape token is a unlock token awarded to Fresh Start Accounts that reach virtual level 120 Summoning during the Fresh Start Worlds gamemode.
The token can be traded, once, directly to another player (it is not available on the Grand Exchange).

p: On the Zombie pirate's ship on Harmony island floor 2 (four spawns)
On the Zombie pirate's ship on Harmony island floor 3
sc: Four kegs spawn on the upper level of the zombie pirate's ship on Harmony Island, but they cannot be picked up, prompting the message "You do not need one of those at the moment.
Kwuarm gloves are a reward that can be obtained by being purchased with 200 tokens from the Fist of Guthix minigame, or with 100 thaler from Stanley Limelight's store.

p: In the Fisher King's realm (three spawns)
sc: If carrying the holy table napkin, it can also be found on Draynor Manor's top floor.
It can also be re-obtained at May's Quest Caravan after putting 150 quest points into the Hub Track.
A mahogany cape rack flatpack can be made at a workbench (Bench with vice or better) in the workshop of a player-owned house.
Marmaros ore can be found in the Sinkholes Distraction and Diversion.
The mechanical spider leg 7 is found in the darker dimension during the 2016 Halloween event.
All 8 legs and 500 reward points can be exchanged for the Dr Spider MD pet.
A medium fallen star (Magic) is an uncommon prize from Treasure Hunter that can be redeemed for bonus experience in the Magic skill.
2× the experience given by a medium XP lamp.
The Medium fortune star (Crafting) is a reward for completing a cloud of destiny in the Crafting skill, as part of the Spring Fayre event.
The memoriam crystal 08 is a memoriam crystal found within Prifddinas.
It is found by planting a bush in the bush patch in Crwys district, and then checking its health once it is fully grown.

Menaphos Faction (Worker) Legs.x: The Menaphos Faction (Worker) Legs are a cosmetic override reward from the Worker district of Menaphos for having 60,000 reputation with that district.

sc: It can be woven at a loom, found at the Falador farm, the Crafting Tutor in Taverley, or at the Cadarn Clan in Prifddinas.
It can be made by anyone with the required Crafting level and at least level 30 for all skills.
Miner's journal #5 is a journal obtained from killing Ripper Demons.
This journal is only obtainable after miner's journal #4 has been received and read.
Mithril bolts are crossbow bolts made from mithril bars.
The occult gorajan trailblazer legs is a reward from Treasure Hunter.
It can be traded, but only for other parts of the gorajan trailblazer set.

q: Puffer, Ray, Octopus, and Monkfish hats.

sc: The yellow orchid seeds are a quest item given to the player during Garden of Tranquillity quest.
To obtain the seeds, the player must grow some onions in an allotment patch west of Port Phasmatys after speaking to Lyra.
It is obtained by using Eric's hook on the bed in the player's jail cell on Rock Island Prison.
It can be combined with Eric's hook to obtain Eric's hook attached to cloth.
It is made by using two soft clay on a potter's wheel, requiring 32 Crafting and giving 28 experience.
Complete directions on how to make tea can be found here.
The Primal 2h Sword (Red) Token (untradeable) is a reward from the 2024 Christmas event's Santa's Christmas Present.

h: Via the Advent Calendar (2021) on 1, 12, and 22 December
Via the Advent Calendar (2020) on 5, 13, and 24 December
Via the Advent Calendar (2019) on 6, 14, and 22 December
sc: Rainbow Gaze is a cosmetic override aura unlocked by redeeming a rainbow gaze token, which can be received during various occurrences of the Rainbow's End promotion on Treasure Hunter since 25 April 2019.
It is unlocked by inspecting the Ramsay pet, found while training Cooking.
The red hand cave painting is a relic component that is found by bringing, and sacrificing, a restored Thorobshuun battle standard to the north tunnel entrance in the Warforge Dig Site.
It could be found in the crates in Diango's Workshop.
The seeds may be obtained through pickpocketing gnomes, elves, or dwarf traders, by hunting jadinkos, and by defeating TzekHaar creatures.
The sacred clay helm is obtained as a reward from the Stealing Creation minigame.
Salve shoes is an item that can only be obtained and used while training Dungeoneering inside Daemonheim.
It may be picked up from the table at the beginning of a dungeon, obtained as a monster drop, or produced using the Crafting skill.
It is unlocked, along with its off-hand counterpart, by redeeming a Santa claws token which can be won on Treasure Hunter during the Advent Calendar (2019) promotion.
The Seer's headband 1 is an item and a reward from the Easy Seers' Village achievements.
When it is given to the player, the Seer would claim it would improve your defence against magic.

s: Tool Shop (Slime is of the Essence)
Tool Shop (Slime is of the Essence)
sc: More slime hunter basic tools may be purchased with Loyalty Points.
A set of 30 basic tools can be purchased for 5,000 loyalty points and a set of 100 basic tools can be purchased for 12,000 loyalty points.
A small XP lamp (Firemaking) is a common prize from Treasure Hunter.
A smouldering fever grass is created when lighting fever grass with the main hand slot empty.
Burning fever grass is a great way to obtain ashes in bulk, especially when players put fever grass and smouldering fever grass on the action bar, and use the hotkeys.
They could be found in the troughs behind the anvil inside the workshop.
Sunfury (Tier 2) is a set of cosmetic overrides unlocked with solar flares collected from Treasure Hunter or by training Divination during 29 September to 3 October 2016.
Before a higher tier can be bought, previous tiers must also be bought.

Theatrical skirt (blue).x: The blue theatrical skirt is part of the theatrical outfit item set. It gives no bonuses and is a cosmetic item.

sc: A thigat shortbow is an item that can only be obtained and used while training Dungeoneering.
It is available as a monster drop, from the starting room table along with Argonite arrows (80 Ranged required) or if the player previously obtained it from a members' world.
Aside from this, the item cannot be obtained.
The outfit has also been available in the Yak Coin Shop for 6 Yak coins.

v: Only before completing the quest Dishonour among Thieves.
Only after completing the quest Dishonour among Thieves.
sc: An uncut emerald can be crafted into an emerald, requiring level 27 Crafting and yielding 67.
Although formally released on 8 May 2001, uncut gems were briefly obtainable following the 17 March 2001 Cooking update, prior to the Crafting skill being fully implemented.
It is received after an unfinished starbloom draft has been drafted to 30% progress completion at the drafting table in the Crafting Guild or Wendlewick.
Valkyrie Bobblehead is a follower pet that is obtained by handing in 17,000 valkyrie feathers to Eir during the Valkyrie's Return event.
It is made by using the vase on the water tap during Peer the Seer's trial.
They were once obtainable by paying 1,500 Renown from the Battle of Lumbridge to the Saradominist quartermaster.
They can now only be obtained as a drop from inside the God Wars Dungeon.
Yewnock's notes is obtained during The Path of Glouphrie quest.
It is found by searching a chest in the northeast room of the Gnome Village Dungeon.
Zodiac shield is an override that was unlocked by handing in 1,000 zodiac talismans during the Zodiac Festival event.

h: Via skilling, Rixie's shop and the cosmetics stall
sc: The Zoltan plushie token is a reward that was first obtainable from the Spring Fayre in 2018.
